nodes.name: Mahalath (Basemath)
nodes.notes: Same mother as firstborn, Nebaioth

nodes.name: Timna
nodes.notes: Concubine of Eliphaz

nodes.name: Anah (Beeri)
nodes.notes: Grandson of Anah

nodes.name: Elon
nodes.notes: A Hittite of Canaan

nodes.name: Shaul
nodes.notes: Son of a Canaanite woman (Gen 46:10)

nodes.name: Er
nodes.notes: Er died in the land of Canaan

nodes.name: Onan
nodes.notes: Onan died in the land of Canaan

nodes.name: Jerahmeel
nodes.notes: Firstborn of Hezron

nodes.name: Ram
nodes.notes: Firstborn

nodes.name: Atarah
nodes.notes: Named as “Another wife” at 1Chron 2:26, indicating the first 5 children are of the first wife

nodes.name: Seled
nodes.notes: Died without sons

nodes.name: Ahlai
nodes.notes: Named as ‘son’ at 1Chron 2:31, but later clarified that Sheshan had only daughters, and married his ‘daughter’ to his egyptian servant, Jarha, to carry his line. Therefore, ‘son’ here I guess is inferring ‘one who carries the bloodline’

nodes.name: Jarha
nodes.notes: An Egyptian slave of Sheshan. See Ahlai

nodes.name: Jether
nodes.notes: Died without sons

nodes.name: Zerubbabel
nodes.notes: Son of Shealtiel. After Shealtiel’s death, it is inferred that Zerubbabel was adopted by his blood uncle, Pediah (who was king), and in turn inherited the kingship

nodes.name: Abiud
nodes.notes: Not a direct kin. Descendant in the genealogy

nodes.name: Jesus Christ
nodes.notes: Son of Jehovah. Green line by Joseph marks inheritance by legal census to the Davidic throne. Light blue line by Mary marks inheritance by blood to the Davidic throne

nodes.name: Jeremiah
nodes.notes: Jeremiah from Libnah

nodes.name: Neri
nodes.notes: Neri is not specified as a woman in the genealogy, however it can be a woman’s name. And since Shealtiel is listed as the direct son of Jehoiachin in the line of kings record, it is assumed that Neri is the mother; especially since the genealogy at Luke already traces Jesus back to David via Mary

nodes.name: Zeruiah
nodes.notes: Zeruiah and Abigail are known as daughters of Nahash. It is unknown whether Nahash was the name of Jesse’s wife, another name of Jesse’s, or perhaps the former husband of Jesse’s wife.

nodes.name: Abigail
nodes.notes: Married to Jether (Ithra) the Israelite (also called an Ishmaelite, likely since he lived in that territory)

nodes.name: Jerioth
nodes.notes: Maid of Azubah. They are credited together as the mother(s) of Jesher, Shobab and Ardon

nodes.name: Hur
nodes.notes: Firstborn of Ephrath(ah), wife of Caleb

nodes.name: Menuhoth
nodes.notes: 1Chron 2:52 states Shobal is father of “half of the Menuhoth” (??)

nodes.name: Salma
nodes.notes: Also called “father of Bethlehem”, likely meaning founder, or that his descendants settled Bethlehem

nodes.name: Manahathite
nodes.notes: 1Chron 2:54 says Salma is father to half of the Manahathites (??)
“Father of Etam”, likely meaning founder @1Chron 4:3

nodes.name: Penuel
nodes.notes: “Father of Gedor” likely meaning founder

nodes.name: Ezer
nodes.notes: “Father of Hushah” likely meaning founder. @1Chron 4:4 Uncertain whether Hushah is a place or person, however considering Ezer is listed along with Penuel who was also called similarly as “father of Gedor”, and Gedor is a town, Hushah was most likely a town lost to history

nodes.name: Mesha
nodes.notes: Firstborn

nodes.name: Mareshah
nodes.notes: Exact relation to Chelubai unknown. Son? Descendant? (Ref. 1Chron 2:42)

nodes.name: Ephah
nodes.notes: Concubine of Caleb

nodes.name: Gazez
nodes.notes: 1Chron2:46 Potentially could be direct son of Caleb, or descendant by means of Haran

nodes.name: Jahdai
nodes.notes: Descendant of Caleb. Exact relation unknown

nodes.name: Maacah
nodes.notes: Concubine of Caleb

nodes.name: Jephunneh
nodes.notes: A Kenizzite associated with (potentially descendant of) the tribe of Judah

nodes.name: Ashhur
nodes.notes: Born after Hezron’s death. “Father of Tekoa” 1Chron 4:5, likely meaning founder as Tekoa is only known as a town

nodes.name: Machir
nodes.notes: Born of a Syrian concubine (1Chron 7:14)

nodes.name: Asenath
nodes.notes: Daughter of Potiphera, the priest of On

nodes.name: Bildad
nodes.notes: Job’s companion at Job 2:11

nodes.name: Sarah
nodes.notes: Half siblings with Abraham. Different mothers

nodes.name: Aram
nodes.notes: Also the name given to the land his children came to reside in, which later became Syria

nodes.name: Sidonians
nodes.notes: A colony of Sidonians came to be settlers of Tyre. Tyre came to surpass Sidon, but never lost its Sidonian heritage. The King of Tyre is also called “King of the Sidonians”

nodes.name: Gibeonites
nodes.notes: Descendants of Hivites who came to reside in the city of Gibeon. Known for later going to serve the Israelites in Joshua’s day
